Awards & Achievements

Kai Shing and Supreme received over 30 certifications in "Excellent Class", the highest level of indoor air quality for its managed premises

Kai Shing Management Services Limited (Kai Shing) and Supreme Management Services Limited (Supreme) are committed to pursuing the highest indoor air quality to provide customers a comfortable and healthy indoor environment. Recently, Kai Shing and Supreme received a total of 45 certifications at the "Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) Certificate Award Ceremony" organised by the Environmental Protection Department (EPD). Among recognitions Kai Shing and Supreme received, 32 managed premises were achieved "Excellent Class", the highest level of IAQ certification, while 9 properties were recognised as premises that have continuously been part of the Scheme for ten or fifteen years. Additionally, Kai Shing was also awarded as one of the top ten organisations with the highest participation rate in the certification programme, demonstrating the relentless effort and dedication of the team in maintaining the highest indoor air quality over the years.

The IAQ Certification Scheme has launched for twenty years, and the management team of Kai Shing and Supreme have been actively enhancing the air quality within properties. For instance, International Commerce Centre (ICC), one of the managed properties participated the Scheme over a decade, has collaborated with the Hong Kong Polytechnic University to establish a real-time indoor air quality monitoring system using the Internet of Things (IoT). The system allows appropriate adjustment on indoor air circulation and filtration systems to respond to the changing air environment. At the same time, some renovated units, gym rooms and office areas are also installed air quality sensors to help the team monitoring the real-time air quality and making adjustments accordingly.

At the same time, some renovated units, gym rooms and office areas are also installed air quality sensors to help the team monitoring the real-time air quality and making adjustments accordingly.

Kai Shing manages a wide range of properties, including residences, office buildings and shopping malls, where many customers spend long hours indoor for living, working or shopping. Therefore, the team understands the importance of maintaining good air quality. In addition to introducing new technologies to improve air quality, the team also actively seek collaborations with universities and relevant organisations to jointly monitor the air quality, and the achievements are evident to all in the current ceremony. Joining hands with our stakeholders, Kai Shing will continue to maintain the air quality within properties, aiming to create a healthier and more comfortable living environment for all.
